tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current price of a major cryptocurrency, gold or silver (Chainlink on Base), or an exchange rate between two currencies. Use for quick quotes of well-known assets; call list_price_symbols when unsure a symbol is covered. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: list_price_symbols
tools.description: Every crypto, metal and currency symbol get_price supports. Call it before get_price when unsure a symbol is covered. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The AI models (chat, images or audio) available through SingIt, with their prices. They are called through SingIt's OpenAI-compatible API at https://app.singitai.app/v1 (or https://ask.singitai.app over x402), not through these MCP tools. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Your SingIt API balance: available and held USDC, auto top-up and pending top-ups. Use to check funds before paid calls. Free, but needs your API key.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches the web through Exa and returns titles, URLs and snippets of matching pages. Use for current or niche information, then read_page for a full page. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC on Base or Solana; needs the key's "search" scope.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The readable text of one web page (up to 8000 characters), through Exa. Use after web_search, or when you already have a URL. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC on Base or Solana; needs the key's "search" scope.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: A sample weather forecast from GoPlausible's x402 demo service on Algorand. Takes no location and returns a fixed example, so it is mainly useful to try a paid call end to end. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_singit_risk_check
tools.description: SingIt's risk check on Bankr x402 Cloud, run on a fixed sample payment request (no input). Mainly useful to try a paid call end to end. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_x_profile
tools.description: Public profile data for an X (Twitter) account by username, from twit.sh's x402 API. Use to check who is behind a handle. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Latest crypto market headlines with sentiment, from Otto AI. Use to see what is moving the market today; takes no input. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_market
tools.description: One Hyperliquid perpetual market (e.g. BTC): price, funding, open interest, max leverage and size rules, from Otto AI. Use for Hyperliquid's own contract details; use get_funding_rates to compare venues. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Funding rates for one symbol across exchanges, with open interest, long/short ratio, large positions and liquidations, from Otto AI. Use to compare venues or gauge positioning; use get_hyperliquid_market for one Hyperliquid contract. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Turns an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) into its address, or an address into its primary ENS name. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: USD price of a major token by symbol from a paid x402 price API. get_price is free and covers the same majors, so prefer it; use this as a second source. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
